design: Integration smoke, known training controls, no independent holdout or language-causal attribution.
source_language: Python-syntax DSL subset, no source execution

frontend_extension.backend: Unchanged finite DSL,24nodes,10000fuel. No arbitrary Python execution.
frontend_extension.grid: g[y][x] reads grid_get(g,coord(x,y)); g[y][x]=color(c) writes a new grid binding. Indices must lower to valid Offset values; coord clamps. Single indexing of lists/tuples is NOT supported.
frontend_extension.attributes: obj.pos and obj.color; Coord.x/.y. a.kind/.dx/.dy and a.x/.y use action accessors; coordinates and offsets from actions are Option and need option_default.
frontend_extension.methods: objects(g) or g.objects(), g.background(), g.grid_get(coord), obj.contains(coord). No unknown attributes or method keywords.
frontend_extension.for: for obj in objects(g): ... may update exactly one preexisting accumulator variable. It lowers to fold over a snapshot with lambda-local obj. Body supports accumulator assignments and if/else updates. No nested loops, break, continue, return, for-else or escaping obj.
frontend_extension.control: Outside a fold only a final if/else whose branches return is supported. No while, arbitrary operators, comparisons or pass. Use eq_kind, eq_color etc and typed literal helpers kind/color/offset.
frontend_extension.limits: These forms do not enlarge literal domains, type relations, AST budget or runtime semantics. Return Pair[Grid,State].
